title: TransitionAbilityDescriptorIncrement
description: Schema delta added to the existing AbilityDescriptor (plan v4.1.1 §1.6) by RFC-006. Existing descriptor fields (name, owner_agent_ura, visibility, scope_*, source, schema_summary, hints) are unchanged and not repeated here. This schema describes ONLY the new RFC-006 fields. The 'class' field is mandatory on every descriptor; 'transition_id', 'state_type', 'state_key_arg', and the [transition] block are mandatory iff class == 'Transition'.

class.description: Three-way classification (RFC-006 §1). Query: no state mutation, receipt proves observation. Transition: state mutation, receipt proves pre/post. Stream: long-lived observation or bidi transport, receipt proves stream lifecycle.

transition_id.description: Stable identifier for the transition (TR-INV-7). MUST be present iff class == 'Transition'. MUST equal the transition_id field on emitted receipts.

state_type.description: The typed state object this ability acts on (TR-INV-1). MUST be present iff class == 'Transition'.

state_key_arg.description: Name of an input arg whose stringified value is the state object's key (TR-INV-8). MUST be present iff class == 'Transition'. The runtime reads args[state_key_arg], canonicalizes to a string, and uses it as the state_key on the receipt. Missing or non-stringifiable value MUST yield InvalidArgument.

transition.description: Allowed pre/post states for this transition (TR-INV-2). MUST be present iff class == 'Transition'.

from_states.description: List of state names from which this transition is legal. Use ['*'] to mean 'any state' (e.g. media.call.end legal from any state).

to_state.description: Single target state name. Multi-target transitions MUST be split into multiple distinct ability descriptors with distinct transition_ids.

then.$comment: Query descriptors MAY declare state_type for grouping/discovery, but MUST NOT declare a [transition] block — TR-INV-5.
Stream descriptors MAY declare state_type for grouping. Stream session lifecycle is separate from frame payloads — TR-INV-6.
